note: The library's shelves. `level` is the HSK band a story is written for; `words` is the vocabulary the reading gate counts, so a book you cannot read yet can tell you exactly what you are missing. Lines carry their own pinyin and meaning, and are mirrored into translations.json so highlighting a sentence inside a book works like it does anywhere else.

stories.blurbEn: It gets light, and the day begins.

lines.pinyin: Tiān liàng le.
lines.en: It has grown light.

lines.pinyin: Wǒ qǐchuáng, hē yì bēi shuǐ.
lines.en: I get up and drink a glass of water.

lines.pinyin: Māma zài zuò zǎofàn.
lines.en: Mum is making breakfast.

lines.pinyin: Wǒ shuō: zǎoshang hǎo!
lines.en: I say: good morning!

lines.pinyin: Jīntiān tiānqì hěn hǎo.
lines.en: The weather is lovely today.

lines.pinyin: Wǒmen yìqǐ qù gōngyuán.
lines.en: We go to the park together.

lines.pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ de jiā.
lines.en: This is my home.

lines.pinyin: Jiā lǐ yǒu sān ge rén.
lines.en: There are three people in it.

lines.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu yì zhī xiǎo māo.
lines.en: I have a little cat.

lines.pinyin: Xiǎo māo xǐhuan shuìjiào.
lines.en: The cat likes to sleep.

lines.zh: 我的房间不大，但是很干净。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ de fángjiān bú dà, dànshì hěn gānjìng.
lines.en: My room is not big, but it is very clean.

lines.pinyin: Wǒ hěn xǐhuan wǒ de jiā.
lines.en: I like my home very much.

stories.blurb: 去超市，回来的路上下雨了。
stories.blurbEn: A trip to the supermarket, and rain on the way home.

lines.zh: 星期六，我和朋友去超市。
lines.pinyin: Xīngqīliù, wǒ hé péngyou qù chāoshì.
lines.en: On Saturday I go to the supermarket with a friend.

lines.pinyin: Wǒmen yào mǎi shuǐguǒ hé miànbāo.
lines.en: We want to buy fruit and bread.

lines.pinyin: Píngguǒ hěn xīnxiān, yě bú guì.
lines.en: The apples are fresh, and not expensive either.

lines.zh: 朋友说：再买一点鸡蛋吧。
lines.pinyin: Péngyou shuō: zài mǎi yìdiǎn jīdàn ba.
lines.en: My friend says: let us get some eggs as well.

lines.pinyin: Wǒmen mǎi le hěn duō dōngxi.
lines.en: We buy a great deal.

lines.pinyin: Huí jiā de shíhou, xià yǔ le.
lines.en: On the way home, it starts to rain.

stories.blurb: 一个老人，一把蓝色的伞。
stories.blurbEn: An old man, and a blue umbrella.

lines.pinyin: Wàimiàn xià zhe yǔ.
lines.en: Outside, it is raining.

lines.pinyin: Wǒ méiyǒu dài sǎn.
lines.en: I did not bring an umbrella.

lines.zh: 一个老人给了我一把伞。
lines.pinyin: Yí ge lǎorén gěi le wǒ yì bǎ sǎn.
lines.en: An old man gave me one.

lines.pinyin: Wǒ shuō xièxie, tā xiào le xiào.
lines.en: I said thank you, and he smiled.

lines.zh: 雨停了以后，天空很干净。
lines.pinyin: Yǔ tíng le yǐhòu, tiānkōng hěn gānjìng.
lines.en: After the rain stopped, the sky was very clear.

lines.zh: 我记住了那把蓝色的伞。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ jìzhù le nà bǎ lánsè de sǎn.
lines.en: I have not forgotten that blue umbrella.

stories.blurb: 奶奶的箱子里，每张照片后面都有一个故事。
stories.blurbEn: In grandmother's box, every photograph has a story behind it.

lines.zh: 奶奶的箱子里有很多老照片。
lines.pinyin: Nǎinai de xiāngzi lǐ yǒu hěn duō lǎo zhàopiàn.
lines.en: There are many old photographs in grandmother's box.

lines.zh: 照片上的人穿着旧衣服。
lines.pinyin: Zhàopiàn shàng de rén chuān zhe jiù yīfu.
lines.en: The people in them are wearing old clothes.

lines.zh: 她指着一张说：这是你爷爷。
lines.pinyin: Tā zhǐ zhe yì zhāng shuō: zhè shì nǐ yéye.
lines.en: She points at one and says: this is your grandfather.

lines.pinyin: Nà shíhou tā hái hěn niánqīng.
lines.en: He was still very young then.

lines.zh: 我发现奶奶的眼睛亮了起来。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ fāxiàn nǎinai de yǎnjing liàng le qǐlái.
lines.en: I notice grandmother's eyes light up.

lines.zh: 每一张照片后面都有一个故事。
lines.pinyin: Měi yì zhāng zhàopiàn hòumiàn dōu yǒu yí ge gùshi.
lines.en: Behind every photograph there is a story.

stories.blurb: 天黑以后，街上反而更热闹。
stories.blurbEn: After dark the street somehow gets busier.

lines.zh: 天黑以后，街上反而更热闹。
lines.pinyin: Tiān hēi yǐhòu, jiē shàng fǎn'ér gèng rènao.
lines.en: After dark, the street is busier rather than quieter.

lines.zh: 摊主们把灯打开，香味到处都是。
lines.pinyin: Tānzhǔ men bǎ dēng dǎkāi, xiāngwèi dàochù dōu shì.
lines.en: The stallholders switch on their lights, and the smell is everywhere.

lines.zh: 糖葫芦在灯下亮得像红色的宝石。
lines.pinyin: Tánghúlu zài dēng xià liàng de xiàng hóngsè de bǎoshí.
lines.en: Under the lamps the candied hawthorns shine like red stones.

lines.zh: 我排了很久的队，才买到一串。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ pái le hěn jiǔ de duì, cái mǎi dào yí chuàn.
lines.en: I queue a long time before I get one.

lines.zh: 味道又酸又甜，和小时候一样。
lines.pinyin: Wèidào yòu suān yòu tián, hé xiǎo shíhou yíyàng.
lines.en: It is sour and sweet at once, exactly as it was in childhood.

lines.zh: 有些东西离开了才知道有多想念。
lines.pinyin: Yǒuxiē dōngxi líkāi le cái zhīdào yǒu duō xiǎngniàn.
lines.en: Some things you only miss once you have left them.
